notes.title: 1.63d Update
notes.content:
Hi Commanders,   Thanks for all the feedback it's great to see all the HarpGamers streaming in to support this classic.   



We noticed your posts on the lack of a 1.63d update. The team have now updated the game to that version.   



Tip: Lost a window because you dragged it all the way down? Click on the Windows tab and then click on tile or cascade option to get them all back in your view.
